title: COMPUTATIONAL BASIS OF LLM’S DECISION MAKING IN SOCIAL SIMULATION

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting and manipulating 'vectors of variable variations' from the LLM's residual streams corresponding to gender (male vs. female) to measure their causal influence on prosocial decision-making in a simulated Dictator Game.

Extracting and measuring the alignment and magnitude of age-related vectors (varying from 20 to 60) in the LLM's internal representations to evaluate their impact on decisions in a simulated Dictator Game.
